en-US.longDescription:
The Medical Imaging Interaction Toolkit (MITK) is a free open-source software for the development
of interactive medical image processing software. Based on MITK, we provide the MITK Workbench
(Downloads), a powerful and free application to view, process, and segment medical images.
en-US.name: MITK - Medical Imaging and Interaction Toolkit
